nodes.description: Owner address stored by BotProtected; later set to tx.origin by WrappedSienna and used for privileged access checks.
Arbitrary external contract invoked by the checkBots modifier and by list() via low-level call.
Uniswap pair address computed in the constructor and passed to the bot-protection contract.
Public balance mapping mutated by transferFrom, list and the token distribution loop with unchecked arithmetic.
Public allowance mapping; written by approve and by the constructor with uint(-1) infinite approvals.
Fixed total supply used in list() to compute the owner allocation totalSupply * 6 / 100.
Hardcoded Uniswap V2 router used for addLiquidityETH and pre-approved for infinite allowance.
Hardcoded WETH address used when computing the Uniswap pair address.
Base constructor setting protectionFromBots from an external caller-supplied address.
Modifier that performs an unguarded low-level call to protectionFromBots before the modified function body executes.
Constructor that sets owner = tx.origin, computes uniPair and grants infinite allowances.
Payable transfer entrypoint that forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as sender.
Core transfer logic guarded by checkBots, with unchecked allowance/balance updates.
Payable approve implementation writing the allowance mapping for msg.sender.
Owner-only function executing an arbitrary delegatecall with attacker-controlled target and calldata.
Pure function computing the deterministic Uniswap V2 pair address from two tokens.
Owner-only liquidity listing routine that mints balances, calls the router, calls the protection contract and loops over recipients.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, allowance ownership and transfer initiation.
Origin address used as owner and granted infinite allowance in the constructor.
Timestamp used to derive the Uniswap addLiquidityETH deadline in list().
Arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address executing arbitrary code in the token storage context.
Low-level call to protectionFromBots executed before transferFrom state updates, enabling reentrancy and return values that can be ignored.
Low-level call to protectionFromBots inside list() before the distribution loop writes balances.
Unchecked subtraction and addition on balanceOf under Solidity 0.7 without SafeMath.
External call to the Uniswap router forwarding msg.value with msg.sender as recipient and a timestamp deadline.
Unchecked subtraction of the transfer amount from the allowance mapping.
Unchecked multiplication and division totalSupply * 6 / 100 in Solidity 0.7 without SafeMath.
